description: Compare two to four explicit strategy variants with anchored chronological training and untouched cold-start holdouts on one shared historical dataset. A robust verdict requires exact coverage, healthy full-length zero-error execution, nonnegative integer counters, historically replayable inputs, enough trades, and positive return in every holdout. Partial, degraded, malformed, or live-only evidence forces robust:false. Requires a stable idempotency key, includes explicit fees and slippage, and never signs, funds, deploys, or trades.

bars.description: Aligned historical bars split chronologically into training and holdout windows.

capital.description: Fresh starting capital for every training and holdout replay.

fee_bps_per_side.description: Execution fee applied to every simulated fill.

idempotency_key.description: Required stable retry key. Reuse it after any timeout.

market.description: One canonical instrument shared by every variant.

min_train_trades.description: Minimum clean training trades before a variant can be selected.

slippage_bps_per_side.description: Adverse price movement applied to every simulated fill.

variants.description: Two to four bounded strategy variants.

strategy_id.description: Owned Felix-generated strategy UUID. Code in the generation response is for display only.

name: walk_forward_backtest
